Celtics @ Nuggets 8/10 20:30 - Jokic hosts 11-3 Celtics, should be close
Hawks @ Thunder 5/10 19:00 - Thunder missing Holmgren and Jalen Williams
76ers @ Magic 4/10 18:00 - Brown and Banchero out, thin watch

games.notes: Nuggets' Strawther is the only notable absence; Jokic healthy at home against the 11-3 Celtics. Best game on the slate, should be close.
OKC is missing Holmgren, Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace; Atlanta lacks CJ McCollum. Thunder still favored, a watchable but diminished matchup.
Jaylen Brown out, Wade questionable for Philly; Banchero and Isaac out for Orlando. Best team in the East faces a gutted Magic, likely a Sixers win.
Cade Cunningham questionable, Duren out; Pelicans without Mathurin and Murray. Watch if Cade plays, otherwise a Pistons win over a bad team.
Curry, Butler and Porzingis out, Draymond questionable. Hard to justify without Curry; Mavs are shorthanded too (Lively out, Christie questionable).
Capela out and Amen Thompson questionable; Pacers still without Haliburton. Good Houston team against a mid team missing its star, likely lopsided.
Memphis is missing GG Jackson, Jerome, Pippen and Stewart; Cleveland without Mobley and Tyson, Merrill questionable. Two banged-up teams, little to see.
Scottie Barnes and Kawhi Leonard out, RJ Barrett questionable for Toronto; Wizards missing Watkins and Vukcevic. Young teams but no real draw.
Reaves out for LA; Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr. out for Utah. Luka and the 13-2 Lakers should cruise, likely blowout.
Bucks are 1-13 with Dieng and Rollins out; Miami is mid with Gardner out. Skip, likely blowout.
Two bad teams, Kings are 1-12 and Simmons out. Skip.
